metadata.description: Go-to-market skills over a runtime that prices every API call before it makes one.

plugins.name: richapi-gtm-skills
plugins.description: 33 GTM skills for B2B outbound — ICP, list building, waterfall enrichment, research, compliance and export — over a runtime that shows you the bill before you pay it. Every paid call is named and costed before it runs; 11 skills never spend at all. Requires the `richapi` CLI (npm i -g @richapi/gtm-skills) and a RichAPI account for the 22 skills that can spend.
